map.Liebowitz社交焦虑量表(LSAS)，对24个社交/表现情境分别评定恐惧与: Liebowitz Social Anxiety Scale (LSAS) rates fear and avoidance across 24 social/performance situations. Each item has fear (0-3) and avoidance (0-3); total 0-144. Total >60 suggests possible social anxiety disorder.
map.LSAS总分 = 恐惧分合计 + 回避分合计（各条目0-3）；恐惧=11项、回避: LSAS total = sum of fear + sum of avoidance (each item 0-3); fear 11 items, avoidance 11 items; higher total means worse social anxiety.
map.本量表为自助筛查工具，不能替代精神科专业诊断。社交焦虑障碍一线治疗为CBT及SS: This is a self-help screening tool and does not replace psychiatric diagnosis. First-line treatment for social anxiety disorder is CBT and SSRIs.
map.24 情境各评恐惧(0–3)与回避(0–3)：恐惧合计 36、回避合计 28 →: 24 situations each rated fear (0-3) and avoidance (0-3): fear 36, avoidance 28 -> total 64, severe social anxiety; performance 13 items, social 11 items can be viewed separately.
map.恐惧 18 + 回避 12 = 30，轻度，可先行自助暴露练习。: Fear 18 + avoidance 12 = 30, mild; self-help exposure practice can start first.
map.恐惧分与回避分各 0–72，总分 0–144；表演型与社交型分开可定位焦虑情境类: Fear and avoidance subscales each 0-72, total 0-144; splitting performance vs social helps locate anxiety situation types.
map.常用 ≥30 轻、≥60 中重、≥80 重，但须结合临床。: Commonly >=30 mild, >=60 moderate-severe, >=80 severe, but must be combined with clinical judgment.
map.关于「社交恐惧(LSAS)评分器」: About the Liebowitz Social Anxiety Scale (LSAS)
map.社交恐惧(LSAS)评分器。医疗专业工具，基于权威医学标准，仅供参考。: Liebowitz Social Anxiety Scale (LSAS). A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
